title: AI button
description: The corner button that opens the AI sidebar, or the empty place kept for it.

toggleAssistant.label: Open the AI sidebar
toggleAssistant.hint: Opens or closes the assistant beside the app.

getIsShown.label: Shown
getIsShown.hint: Off keeps its place empty, so the corner never shifts for people without AI.

getLook.label: Look
getLook.hint: Rest, hovered, or pressed with the sidebar open.
